Kenney Emotes Pack (v1.0)
Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/emotes-pack
License: CC0 1.0 Universal (original license copied in Assets/Project/ThirdPartyLicenses/Kenney_EmotesPack_Original_License.txt)
This folder contains all 30 PNG icons from the official source ZIP at PNG/Vector/Style 1/, exactly once per semantic icon. The original ZIP has 16 variants/styles of each icon (480 PNG). All are included in the original uploaded archive, but the project imports only one style to prevent duplicate sprite entitlements.
Sprite importer: Atlas Board > QA & Diagnostics > Configure Kenney Emote Sprites
- DO NOT place extracted original ZIP into Assets; those files are already prepared here.
- 30 includes emote__.png (empty bubble decorative control), NOT a purchasable emote.
- 3 free: emote_faceHappy.png, emote_faceSad.png, emote_faceAngry.png.
- Other 26: candidate Gold emotes; they are NOT sold until secured store backend/UI is implemented.
This is ONLY sprite import preparation, not completed Emote purchase, UI or multiplayer code.
